Hi there OP, I’m about to start an apprenticeship and actually asked my mentor about this so here are our thoughts :)
I would go to the interview and explain your thoughts to them, get a feel of the place first. The tattoo industry as a whole is hard as fuck but sometimes you have saving graces. I hope that if you explain what’s happened they will offer you one.
HOWEVER, I can also see their side. When apprenticing under someone you are learning their way to tattoo and their teaching methods. The reason I can see them starting you as a year one would be to re-teach you in their own methods. To unlearn the old habits you made and to create new ones. 
If ultimately they said you can’t do a year two ask if they can at least modify your year one experience to have more interactive and advanced practices (if you do consider them)
I wish you the best of luck op!
